### [Yash] — [Scatterplot, e.g. "Body Mass by Species"]

```{r}
# Make your agreed-upon plot here, e.g.:
penguins |> ggplot(aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = bill_depth_mm, color = factor(bill_depth_mm))) + 
  geom_point(
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.8
    
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Bill length vs bill depth of species ",
    x = "Bill Length in mm",
    y = "Bill depth in mm",
    color = "Bill depth color"
  )
```
